description: The transcripts of SBCSAE. No recipe reads them. The transcripts are CHAT files (conversation turns with speaker labels and time marks) inside a 6.1 GB archive of recordings, more than a fetch holds in memory (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212). The chat parser reads the files, so the size is all that remains.
